ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/grey pixels; white intensity is concentrated in the upper quadrants of both lobes, while dark pixels dominate the central and lower regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white contiguous field on the upper-right lobe with vertical dark linear striations. The left lobe exhibits a smaller, more mottled white field. Extensive low-intensity salt-and-pepper mottling across the lower-center fluke area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree interior angle and significant bounding-box depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits larger, rounded 'scalloped' peaks with higher pixel-amplitude variations compared to the more irregular, jagged topography of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on both lobes, tapering sharply toward the distal tips; trailing edge maintains a generally horizontal sweep with localized irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible clusters of circular high-intensity white pixels (barnacle scars/attachments) along the outer perimeter of the right lobe and concentrated at both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark vertical rake marks (parallel linear disruptions) visible on the white field of the right lobe; finer, unaligned diagonal scratches detected on the pigmented area of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological accretion (barnacles) and possibly associated brown organic material at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; visible irregular indentation on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of brownish-red organic material or kelp-like clusters protruding from the outer edges of the distal tips.
